hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; REPO=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$REPO" ] && exit 0; git -C "$REPO" add "$f" && git -C "$REPO" commit -m "Update $(basename "$f")" && git -C "$REPO" push; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Commitando e enviando para o repositório...
